name: Arc Totem Hierophant
summary: The Tendrils totem is the default link: Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity channels a semicircle in front of the totem, and every fifth pulse is stronger (a much larger area and an automatic critical strike), so the same six-link clears packs and kills bosses from two Spell Totems. The measured damage is per totem. Arc drops into the four-link helmet when an open layout wants a chain more than a frontal pulse. The Hierophant totem package pays for both totems, and no unique is required: a rare six-link, a spell sceptre and capped resistances are the core of the bill. For spread packs, swap Concentrated Effect for Increased Area of Effect or use the Arc helmet.

pros.text: One six-link body carries the default link; Arc sits in a four-link helmet for open layouts.
No required unique; a rare spell sceptre, rares and a cheap transfigured gem carry the build.
Totems channel while you move, so positioning is far less punishing than self-cast.
The always-crit pulse makes the boss link a real single-target tool, and two totems fight at once.
Determination, Granite and Basalt flasks and Conviction of Power's endurance charges make the life pool real.
The channel covers a semicircle in front of the totem, so clear needs no projectile.

cons.text: Both totems must survive the whole fight; area damage deletes them and the damage stops.
The default link needs a transfigured gem from the Divine Font or from trade.
Clear is a totem's clear, not a bow build's; you walk between packs and wait for placement.
Blasphemy, Determination and Clarity leave only a few casts of unreserved mana; the mana flask is part of the rotation.
A phase that pulls you away from the totems costs uptime; the channel only damages what the totem can see.
Awakened supports are the real pinnacle bill; the red-map paste uses the regular versions.

swaps.note: Transfigure a Lightning Tendrils at the Divine Font in the Merciless Labyrinth, or buy one; the base gem carries the campaign.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.
The default link is Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity on Spell Totems: its wide pulse clears and its always-crit larger pulse bosses. Arc keeps the four-link helmet for open layouts.
The gate report measures the default link at red maps and pinnacle; the published paste holds both links, and the four-link Arc is the clear swap.
Lightning Tendrils, self-cast and then on Spell Totem, carries the campaign; the transfigured version takes over at the Merciless Labyrinth.
Awakened Added Lightning Damage, Awakened Lightning Penetration and Awakened Elemental Focus lift pinnacle damage; the red-map paste keeps the regular supports so the import stays self-fundable.
Arcane Blessing and Blasphemy with Conductivity are the damage layers; Determination, a Granite flask, a Basalt flask and Conviction of Power are the physical layer.
The tree buys life first and reaches a nine-thousand-life pool at pinnacle; chaos resistance is capped and every checkpoint now passes the standard floors rather than the lower Dad damage floor.
Ratings move from 6/6/5/8 to 10/10/9/9 on the measured gates; the medal moves from B to S+.

summary.text: Arc Totem Hierophant runs Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity on two Spell Totems as its default clear and boss link, and keeps Arc in a four-link helmet for open layouts. The measured link runs 299.9k at red maps and 935.0k at pinnacle per totem. The channel covers a semicircle in front of the totem, and every fifth pulse is stronger (a much larger area and an automatic critical strike), so the same link clears packs and delivers the boss hit. No unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Rolling Magma, then self-cast Lightning Tendrils: the channel hits harder than self-cast Arc before the totem links, and it is the same skill the default link upgrades. The first checkpoint measures 377 life and 49 damage; the second measures 773 damage. Put the Tendrils on Spell Totem, put Arc in the helmet as a three-link alongside the totem body, add Faster Casting when the helmet becomes a four-link, and transfigure a Tendrils at the Divine Font in the Merciless Labyrinth for the upgraded version.

maps.text: At red maps the default link measures 299.9k per totem with 29453 effective life and 11759 physical max hit. It runs Concentrated Effect for that number, so swap the support for Increased Area of Effect (or use the Arc helmet) when a pack is spread; the swap costs some damage, and the Arc helmet's damage is not measured here. The channel covers a semicircle in front of the totem, so the totem clears the pack it is placed in; Arc swaps into the four-link helmet when an open layout wants a chain. Blasphemy with Conductivity is the damage aura, and Determination with a Granite and a Basalt flask is the physical layer. Cap the elemental resistances and keep both totems ahead of you. The tree's fire and cold walkers are planner artifacts: their damage and cast-speed lines are fire/cold-scoped, so a hand-built tree should cut them for a lightning or life cluster.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 935.0k per totem with 42850 effective life and 14097 physical max hit. Place both Tendrils totems before the burst (they expire on a timer, so recast them before they run out) and keep Conductivity on the boss. Replace a totem after every phase that clears the arena; the stronger pulse is the damage window, so the totem has to be channelling before the boss commits to a slam.
